name: user-lifecycle
description: A product manager walks one person through a product and notes where the job breaks.

interface.shortDescription: Walk one user through a product and note where the job breaks
interface.longDescription: One person, one job. Walk the product, save the job card, research facts the job depends on, and write a brief from what survived a check. The product supplies the words.
defaultPrompt: Walk one person through this product from arrival until they finish or give up
Run a usability session on the flow we just built
Confirm this experience and note where the job breaks
Write the job card for this product and save it
